policy_freshness_scope: Resolved local67f806 rule text plus Root explicit direction; child doctor was not-recently-checked, so this review does not claim an independent fresh GitHub policy fetch. No shared infrastructure was changed.

findings_and_closure.original_finding: Renderer shutdown was incorrectly keyed only to health nonce opt-in.
findings_and_closure.resolution: Closed: known rendering commands are classified independently; rendered commands lacking explicit supported health now refuse before launch; possible renderers never use SIGKILL.

findings_and_closure.original_finding: Distinct actual Metal Python parent/child clients were folded as one job.
findings_and_closure.resolution: Closed: separate native GPU children remain separate capacity rows; ancestry is not a capacity exemption.

findings_and_closure.original_finding: A replayed caller health token preceded the newly appended nonce and caused false no-frame timeout.
findings_and_closure.resolution: Closed: caller-supplied/replayed health flags are rejected before child launch or shared pause.

findings_and_closure.original_finding: Leftover mock-stuck configuration could fabricate stuck clients and trigger a real shared pause.
findings_and_closure.resolution: Closed: mock-stuck, utilization mocks, ignore overrides and modified Unreal pattern are refused before final observation.

findings_and_closure.original_finding: A first-frame deadline could expire unnoticed during the full TERM grace wait.
findings_and_closure.resolution: Closed: the same startup health/deadline callback is polled during bounded shutdown; no renderer force-kill was introduced.

findings_and_closure.original_finding: A UV launcher could be removed without retaining its unrecognized native GPU replacement.
findings_and_closure.resolution: Closed: replacement requires a retained counted native child; native descendants of a known ML ancestor are counted, and the targeted counterexample has a regression test.

findings_and_closure.original_finding: A native Metal process in E/Z could escape the stuck list if its executable name was unrecognized.
findings_and_closure.resolution: Closed: all observed native Metal PIDs in E/Z are checked independently of workload-name classification.

findings_and_closure.original_finding: A game argument named --headless after Godot standalone -- could disable renderer protection.
findings_and_closure.resolution: Closed: only actual pre-separator engine flags affect classification and helper health opt-in; positive native-engine observation also supplements the shared classifier.

findings_and_closure.original_finding: Legacy rendered callers had no first-frame protocol and old packages could be falsely opted in.
findings_and_closure.resolution: Closed for supported current-source helper: loop/render.sh is instrumented. Uninstrumented rendered calls refuse before launch; old packages require a new instrumented build/provenance, not a nonce-only workaround.

reviewed_remaining_paths: Fresh per-run stdout log plus exact nonce and child PID reject stale output. Overlong unrelated lines are bounded; a banner/submitted frame is insufficient.

Godot hook runs only with explicit health request, skips headless, awaits frame_post_draw and completes ViewportTexture.get_image before emitting evidence. This source path still needs actual native execution.

Final capacity/utilization/stuck/pause/streaming observation occurs after expensive source/art snapshot and in the process that execs the engine; no earlier stale preflight is treated as current capacity.
Machine pause uses the established shared PAUSED switch with exclusive create and preserves an existing pause. There is no automatic resume or foreign-process kill.
Popen-owned child shutdown uses TERM and bounded wait. A stuck renderer remains explicitly unreaped and causes shared pause; synthetic CPU tests do not prove a real GPU command returned.
Current120second startup threshold is explicitly provisional2x60 expectation in code and metadata. It is not a measured normal startup baseline. Actual clean cold/warm observations remain necessary.

read_only_native_inventory_observation.scope: Parser worked on live registry output only; no Metal/MPS compute probe or engine was started.

required_next_evidence: Normal gated headless/native parse of the new GDScript hook and affected entrypoint.
First controlled rendered run with fresh child PID/nonce and actual viewport readback while capacity/headroom/streaming policy permits.
Record measured startup timing before changing the provisional threshold.
Export instrumented source before testing newly supported packaged captures; historic uninstrumented binaries are not silently made compatible.
not_acceptance_of: Game visuals, source-world traversal or gameplay
Whole machine safety against uncoordinated foreign launchers
